_meta.claim: computeFestivals emits the same festivals for the same context. Each grid varies exactly the fields one matcher arm reads, so a rule filed under the wrong D8 Kind fires under the wrong grid or not at all. ks pins the kshaya containing-day fallback, kl the last-day kala tie-break, nku and nkk the nakshatra arm. FESTIVAL_REGISTRY is module-private and cannot be pinned directly; this pins the dispatch over it.
